result.brief: 提出 Hindsight Forcing，用潜空间直通桥将未来损失梯度回传到历史 chunk 的单个去噪步，无需额外参数即可训练自回归视频扩散的历史上下文写入，缓解长 rollout 的视觉漂移与结构崩塌。
result.reason: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion training method improving long-rollout history conditioning via latent straight-through gradient bridge; directly serves autoregressive video generation and long-video stability.
